modules.module_title: Carry out intial set up,centering and levelling of survey equipment (levels, theodolite, total station etc.)

pcs.pc_description: locate the station mark on the ground surface
place the tripod over the station mark
fix the instrument on the tripod head
level the instrument by adjusting the legs of tripod
ensure that the legs of tripod are sufficient distance apart and are pressed firmly on the ground to provide stability to the instrument
ensure that the height of instrument is such that it is convenient to take readings
perform the centering of the instrument over the station mark by using plumb bob, optical plummet or laser pointer as per applicability
adjust the levels of horizontal and vertical axis of the instruments using standard references/indicators such as bubble tubes, spirit level and adjustable screws as per standard practices
focus the telescope on the concerned object or point for clear visibility, by adjusting the eyepiece/ knobs/screw and cross-hair

modules.module_title: Conduct linear measurements using chain and measuring tape for measurement in plans and slopes

pcs.pc_description: interpret site drawings, layout plans, and boundary maps etc
estimate the optimal length of chain required for measuring the required distance
select suitable tools, instruments and marking materials for conducting required work
identify the start point/ benchmark for measurement as per work requirement
monitor subordinates to ensure that the unfolding of the chain or tape is as per standard practice
check that the subordinates have collected appropriate tools such as arrows, pegs etc. in required number
check that the ranging rods are vertical and of appropriate length to avoid any errors in ranging
ensure that the chain or tape is stretched appropriately to avoid any errors due to sagging of the same
coordinate between leader and follower to maintain straight line of measurement and proper placement of flags or pegs
ensure that the peg is fixed at all station points of the survey
record the chainages or measured distance for respective points using proper symbols in the field book, as per standard practice
instruct subordinates to use appropriate tools for transferring points on ground/ slopes

modules.module_title: Conduct linear measurement using total stations

pcs.pc_description: identify the location of master and secondary control points to set up the instrument
identify the suitable benchmark as a reference to obtain a back-sight at station point
locate the exact position of the instrument with respect to the back-sight and foresight points
set up the instrument exactly over the station point
carry out temporary adjustments of the instrument
input various data/parameters as per job details, locations and technical specifications
identify the location of staff point for measuring the horizontal distance as per the drawings or co-ordinates
instruct the subordinate to hold the staff exactly at the staff point
operate the total station instrument to compute and record the required data
remove the data card from the instrument and transfer the same into compatible computer

modules.module_title: Carry out leveling and cross section survey using total station

pcs.pc_description: interpret the scope of survey and data to be collected
identify and locate the first station point to set up the instrument
identify and locate the benchmark on the field as instructed by the surveyor
setup the instrument exactly over the station point
carry out temporary adjustments of the instrument
input data regarding temperature and pressure bars into the total station
input the data regarding survey job, station point, type of measurement, RL of benchmark etc. as required by the instrument
instruct the subordinate to hold the reflective staff exactly over the benchmark of known elevation
bisect the reflective prism mounted on the staff with the help of tangent screw and fine tune screw
bisect the prism using the input panel on the total station to compute the reduced level at the station point from the RL earlier fed in the instrument using the telescope
identify the direction and position of the terminal point/ station and place the staff
obtain the RL(reduced level) of the staff point by bisecting the reflective prism and instructing the instrument to calculate the RL
follow the standard procedure to obtain readings at multiple staff points at fixed interval
transfer the instrument to the next point as per requirement and take a back sight reading at the previous intermediate point or staff point
take staff readings at fixed interval on multiple points normal to the center line on both sides
check the display of the instrument to confirm that data displayed is as per requirement
remove the data card from the instrument and transfer the same into compatible computer

modules.module_title: Perform preparatory activities prior to setting out

pcs.pc_description: obtain work instructions, plans, specifications, quality requirements and operational details
plan the sequence to be adopted for setting out works
check the serviceability of the required tools and instruments and report any errors/ faults to the seniors
estimate the required materials and ensure that they comply with work requirements
locate and identify the survey pegs or control point and mark the boundary lines
calculate the distance and direction of building line from the boundary or base line as per plans/drawings
carry out liner and angular measurements to locate the building line on field from the boundary or baseline
identify all the grid lines /numbers provided on the plans/drawings and establish them on the ground using string (line dori) and pegs
conduct the erection/construction of profile/hurdles/platform at the both ends of grid lines and mark them as per their grid numbers
determine the corner of building on set building line to true measurement from adjacent boundary and mark the same as per drawings and specifications
set out right angle to the building line from the identified corner point using TS, theodolite or triangulation principals
recheck all the measurements accurately using TS or triangulation methods and confirm the same with drawings

modules.module_title: Ensure effective implementation of health, safety and environment policies and procedures

pcs.pc_description: implement safe handling and stacking methods at workplace /store
ensure the adequate availability and placing of safety and protection installations at site
ensure that safe access ways are available at work place for movement of workers and materials
ensure the safe use of tools and tackles by teammates as per work requirements
ensure ergonomic principles are adopted by the teammates while lifting and shifting of construction materials, tools and equipment

ensure appropriate use of following Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) as per work requirement of head protection, ear protection, fall protection, foot protection, face and eye protection, hand and body protection, respiratory protection
maintain entry and exit pathways from confined spaces, excavated pits and other location as per safety parameters/instructions
ensure proper housekeeping at workplace
ensure that subordinates adhere to health and safety plans

implement control measures to reduce risks ,meeting legislative requirements within the scope of own role and expertise, as per organizational policies
